environment: macOS ARM64; workspace dev-profile libraries (unoptimized); real pinned Foyer; immediate InMemObjectStore backend
method: 5 alternating before/after trials; each scenario 50 warmup + 500 measured samples. Summary values are medians of per-trial percentiles/GET counts, not pooled percentiles. Window=8 except single_slot=1; pair delays occur inside second Foyer producer. cross_runtime=true builds Foyer on separate 2-worker runtime; caller=current-thread; dedicated=true uses RW 2-worker IO runtime. An identity assertion outside timing was added and passed in final verification.
baseline: Previous local ready-only registration-drop implementation, not original remote branch HEAD.
